findings: Zero route guard components exist. 256 protected routes have no guards.
Role-based access is UI-only (canView filter). Server does not enforce.
Privilege escalation possible by URL manipulation.
82.6% of API endpoints have no authentication requirement.
No HTTPS enforcement in mock mode (expected).
No TLS configuration found.
OTP codes handled in plaintext in mock client.
No encryption for localStorage/sessionStorage (not used).
No SQL/NoSQL queries in frontend code.
React's JSX provides automatic output encoding.
No dangerouslySetInnerHTML or innerHTML usage found.
No eval() usage found.
Input validation exists for auth forms (phone, email).
Authentication is entirely mock-based — no real auth implemented.
Session management is stubbed (mock OTP, mock tokens).
No rate limiting on auth endpoints (login, OTP, register).
No CSRF protection mechanism found.
No security-by-design patterns observed.
No CSP (Content Security Policy) configured — XSS risk.
No X-Frame-Options header — clickjacking risk.
No X-Content-Type-Options header.
No Strict-Transport-Security header.
Vite dev server has host:true (exposed to network).
Debug endpoints left enabled (demo pages in production routes).
Only 3 runtime dependencies with no known critical CVEs.
React 18.3.1 — latest stable.
React Router 6.26.2 — latest stable.
Vite 5.4.6 — recent stable.
No `npm audit` performed — dependency tree not audited.
Mobile apps have declared but uninstalled dependencies.
No real authentication flow — entirely mock-based.
Default role is 'administrator' — no auth check at all.
Auth client is a stub with 900ms mock delay.
No session token implementation.
No MFA/2FA.
No biometric auth (planned but not implemented).
No account lockout.
No password policies.
All dependencies from official npm registry.
Subresource Integrity (SRI) not configured on script tags.
No CI/CD pipeline analyzed.
No centralized logging mechanism.
console.log statements found that could leak data in production.
No security event logging (failed logins, access attempts).
No audit trail for sensitive operations.
Error handling reveals component structure in console.
No server-side URL fetching implemented in this codebase.
No external resource loading vulnerable to SSRF.

otp.details: Mock OTP. Any code except '000000' is accepted. No rate limiting.

session_tokens.details: No real token implementation. Mock JWT in mobile-core but unused in web-app.

rate_limiting.details: No rate limiting on any auth endpoint.

privilege_escalation.details: No guard components. Direct URL access to any admin route possible without authentication.

route_bypass.details: All routes are accessible via direct URL entry. No route guards exist.

hidden_api_access.details: API endpoints lack authentication on 82.6% of routes.

role_manipulation.details: Role is stored in React state (activeRole). Any user can change role via the UI dropdown.

admin_endpoint_access.details: All /admin/* routes accessible without any authentication.

authorization_headers.details: 128 endpoints have no auth header requirement.

idor.details: No ownership verification on any controller. Any user could access any resource.

mass_assignment.details: Controllers use full DTO classes. Risk of mass assignment if input binding is not filtered.

parameter_tampering.details: No input validation on controller parameters in many endpoints.

hardcoded_secrets.details: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords found.

console_log_leakage.details: console.log statements found in code that should be removed for production.

source_maps.details: Vite build disabled sourcemaps by default.

vulnerabilities.title: No route guards on any protected route
Default role is administrator — no auth enforcement
Authentication is entirely mock-based — no real auth
82.6% of endpoints have no authentication
Role can be changed via UI dropdown — no server enforcement
No CSP header configured
No X-Frame-Options — clickjacking risk
No security headers configured at all
IDOR vulnerability — no ownership verification on controllers
No session management or token expiry
OTP accepts any code except 000000 — no real validation
No rate limiting on login, OTP, or register endpoints
No CSRF protection mechanism
Error details may leak component structure
No security audit trail or event logging
No rate limiting on API endpoints
No HTTP method restrictions on API endpoints
console.log statements in production code
No Subresource Integrity on script tags
Vite dev server exposed to network (host: true)
API endpoints use no authorization headers
No server-side input validation on controller parameters

recommendations: CRITICAL: Implement route guard components for all 256 protected routes immediately
CRITICAL: Remove default administrator role — require explicit authentication
CRITICAL: Implement real authentication flow (Supabase or custom auth service)
CRITICAL: Add authentication to all 128 unauthenticated API endpoints
HIGH: Add server-side authorization — role stored in JWT, not UI state
HIGH: Configure CSP header with strict policy
HIGH: Configure X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS headers
HIGH: Implement ownership verification on all resource endpoints (IDOR prevention)
HIGH: Implement proper session management with JWT tokens and expiry
HIGH: Add input validation on all controller parameters
HIGH: Add authentication/authorization headers to all API endpoints
MEDIUM: Implement rate limiting on auth endpoints (login, OTP, register)
MEDIUM: Implement CSRF tokens for state-changing operations
MEDIUM: Remove console.log statements before production
MEDIUM: Add security event logging and audit trail
MEDIUM: Implement account lockout after failed login attempts
LOW: Remove host:true from vite.config.ts for production
LOW: Add Subresource Integrity hashes to script tags
